# Companion repositories

The planned MPM submodule will live at `external/micropowermanager/` and reference
an exact published commit from the team MPM fork. It has not been added yet.
Until then, follow the sibling-clone instructions in the [development guide](../docs/development.md#mpm-development).

Push and verify the MPM commit before recording its submodule reference.
Do not copy the full MPM source tree into the gateway repository.
